# Michael E. Krone, D.D.S. Family Dentistry

> > Comprehensive family dentistry practice in Richmond and Farmville, VA offering cosmetic, restorative, and specialized dental treatments with patient-centered care.

Dr. Michael E. Krone operates a full-service family dentistry practice across two Virginia locations, specializing in general dentistry, cosmetic procedures, sedation options, and specialized treatments like TMJ therapy and Invisalign. The practice emphasizes preventive care and patient education.

## Core Services

- [Family Dentistry](https://www.drkrone.com/service/family-dentistry): General family dentistry services including checkups and preventive care
- [Treatments Overview](https://www.drkrone.com/treatments): Comprehensive dental treatments: implants, cosmetic, sedation, root canals
- [Dental Conditions](https://www.drkrone.com/conditions): Patient education on common dental conditions and treatment options

## Cosmetic & Specialty Services

- [Invisalign](https://www.drkrone.com/service/invisalign): Invisalign clear aligners for teeth straightening by Dr. Krone
- [Teeth Whitening](https://www.drkrone.com/service/teeth-whitening): Teeth whitening service with in-office and take-home treatment options
- [TMJ Treatment](https://www.drkrone.com/service/tmj-treatment): TMJ treatment for jaw pain and temporomandibular joint disorders
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://www.drkrone.com/service/conscious-sedation): Sedation dentistry options including nitrous oxide and oral sedation
